records.source_span: As a local historian and curator of the Portsmouth Historical Society Archive, I bring my passion for New Hampshire's political past to classrooms, community events, and public lectures. Whether I'm leading a walking tour along the historic waterfront or hosting a discussion on 19th-century governors, I aim to make our shared history engaging and accessible. My style is approachable—I'm just as likely to give a talk in my favorite jeans and a wool sweater as I am to speak in the formal lecture halls at the University of New Hampshire.
